crossRefs.note: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?

translations.web: His eyes will be red with wine, his teeth white with milk.
translations.bsb: His eyes are darker than wine, and his teeth are whiter than milk.
translations.kjv: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
translations.asv: His eyes shall be red with wine, And his teeth white with milk.
